bio: Are you looking for a slice of the French way of life in the middle of Potsdam? In the Holländisches Viertel (Dutch Quarter), you will find this beautifully designed restaurant, which is housed in a charming 17C half-timbered house. The dining space comprises three different levels, where you can enjoy ambitious classic cuisine accompanied by just the right wine, as a discreet soundtrack plays in the background. In addition to the menu, you can also choose a few dishes à la carte. If the weather is nice, would you like an aperitif at one of the small tables on the pavement before your meal?...
